issue.title: Prevent interaction between source-only repositories and searchable snapshots

labels.name: :Distributed/Snapshot/Restore
labels.description: Anything directly related to the `_snapshot/*` APIs

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Source-only repositories and searchable snapshots don't mix, but today we don't have any special handling to prevent users from trying to mix them. A [user on the forums reported](https://discuss.elastic.co/t/issue-using-searchable-snapshots-in-an-ilm-policy/262001) that this does lead to errors but they're pretty obscure.

We should decide whether to support this combination or not. If not then we should reject it in a clearer and more actionable fashion.

issue.title: Object mapper: merge enabled flag only when explicitly set

labels.name: :Search Foundations/Mapping
labels.description: Index mappings, including merging and defining field types

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Currently, when merging an object through put mapping, the default value for enabled is applied, which is true. In case the object has been previously disabled, that is going to cause an error although the updated mapping does not attempt to change the value for the enabled flag.

What needs to happen instead is that the enabled flag is applied only when set explicitly.

Closes #67972
